Stuck on something? Here's where to turn.

## Look it up

- **[Get Started](../get-started/index.qmd)** walks through a whole analysis,
  from reading a file to summarising the movement.
- **Each package's site** has a help page for every function, with examples.
  [Packages](../packages/index.qmd) links to them all.
- **[Learn](../learn/index.qmd)** collects tutorials on specific problems.

## Ask a question

Ask on the [animovement Zulip chat](https://animovement.zulipchat.com). It's
the place for questions of every kind, from how to do something to why a result
looks odd. Searching it first often turns up an answer straight away.

You'll get a useful answer much faster if you include:

- **A small example that shows the problem.** The best is a few lines of code
  that anyone can run, using `get_sample_data()` or a few made-up rows rather
  than your own files. The [reprex](https://reprex.tidyverse.org) package helps.
- **What you expected**, and what happened instead.
- **Your versions**, from `animovement_sitrep()`.

## Using an AI assistant?

AI assistants often guess at function names, and in a young ecosystem like
this one they often guess wrong. The **`animovement`** agent skill gives an
assistant such as [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) a map of which
package does what and how the data is structured, and tells it to check each
function against the current documentation rather than relying on memory. In
Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add animovement/animovement-agents
/plugin install animovement@animovement
```

Other assistants can use the same skills; see
[animovement-agents](https://github.com/animovement/animovement-agents) for how.
Each package's site also has an `llms.txt`, a plain list of its functions that
any assistant can read, such as
[animetric's](https://animovement.dev/animetric/llms.txt).

## Found a bug?

If something is clearly broken, or you'd like a feature that doesn't exist yet,
please file an issue. [Contribute](../contribute/index.qmd#sec-issues) explains
how, and where.
